name: Inventions
description: The inventions that changed everyday life, from the wheel and the printing press to the light bulb, the transistor and the web.

checkpoints.name: Ancient inventions
checkpoints.note: The wheel, paper, gunpowder, the compass, movable type and glasses: inventions from Mesopotamia, Greece, China and Italy.

checkpoints.name: Print, lenses and steam
checkpoints.note: Gutenberg's press makes books cheap, lenses open up the very far and the very small, and the steam engine gives the first power that does not depend on muscle, wind or water.

checkpoints.name: The age of invention
checkpoints.note: In one century come the battery, the telegraph, the telephone, the light bulb, the motor car and radio.

checkpoints.name: Machines for the home
checkpoints.note: Electricity reaches ordinary homes and brings the vacuum cleaner, the washing machine, the refrigerator and television. The aeroplane, penicillin and the transistor arrive in the same half-century.

checkpoints.name: The electronic age
checkpoints.note: The integrated circuit, the laser, satellite navigation and the web turn electronics into something everyone carries.
